title: FHFA House Price Index — Monthly Index (October 2026 data), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 — (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes), the agency's own "2026 HPI Release Dates" table, row "Tuesday, December 29 | Monthly Index | October 2026"; and (2) the published 2026Q2 report (fhfa.gov/document/d/hpi/fhfa-house-price-index-report-2026q2, HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, 41 pages, released 2026-08-25), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2026" appendix page carries the same row AND states "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET". Promoted estimate -> confirmed by this event's own initial research, on the precedent that the no-self-confirm limit binds the sweep that DISCOVERED an event (fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24), not its independent second look. The 9:00 a.m. ET release time is claimed here BECAUSE that appendix states it — a correction to the sibling ledger, which recorded no time as sourced. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: The October-2026-data monthly edition, and the first FHFA release AFTER cr-expiry-2026-12-11 (eighteen days). That makes it the live, out-of-sample test of the statutory claim the fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24 ledger established: 12 U.S.C. 4516(f)(2)-(3) puts FHFA's assessment income outside appropriated money and outside chapter-15 apportionment, and the record is 222 of 222 months since 2008-03 with 68 of 68 last-Tuesday releases since 2021 (re-derived independently this session off all 11 archive pages, 271 rows). ONE QUALIFICATION THIS SESSION FOUND AND THE SIBLING DID NOT: the December slot is the one month FHFA has historically moved. Only 6 of 18 monthly-era December releases landed on the last Tuesday; 2008-2017 all fell Dec 20-24 to clear Christmas week, and 2020-12-23 was the most recent departure. The last-Tuesday rule has held in December only since 2021 (5 of 5). Reaches no model: 0 hits for fhfa/hpi/house price/case-shiller across both sheets of the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx (re-fetched 2026-09-06, 16,944 bytes) — though note the PostedUpdates sheet's forward horizon ENDS 2026-12-23, six days short of this date, so "no vintage scheduled" is outside coverage here rather than measured. Release slot confounded as ever: 2026-12-29 is the last Tuesday of December, so Conference Board Consumer Confidence shares the day (proposed in this PR). The two are now known to be an hour apart (FHFA 9:00, CB 10:00 per each publisher's own document), which is what an intraday design would need and a daily bar still cannot use. Discovered as a proposal during the fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24 initial research (2026-09-06); this session read that proposal and wrote the canonical file.
